g.text: A breathing body of fine plexus lines;
it erodes to dust as the track builds.
changes apply to every scene unless marked “this scene”
texture on top of every scene · ambient default: film on, digital off
edits on the beat · max 3 a second
Red glow bleeding out of the highlights. Double-click = default.
